messages:
amanda: heads-up — hitting a reproducible viewport/cardinality glitch in the console where rows from the previous org flash in the new org after a fast org switch. steps: open org-A runs -> click org switch -> select org-B -> open runs. saw ~3 rows from A in B's list. :grimacing:
raj: repro'd it locally, can confirm. looks like a stale cache key is being reused when the route changes quickly.
amanda: exact snippet from the browser console: ```GET /api/console/runs?org=org-b&cursor=0 200 OK 
response.rows[0].org_id = "org-a"```
kevin: hmm could be prefetch layer returns earlier promise and we swap orgId after promise resolves. frontend state machine might not cancel the inflight request.
lina: there's also telemetry showing quota counters briefly attributing tokens to the wrong org when this happens — saw a spike in `quota.consumed` labeled with org-a right after switching to org-b.
simon: throwing out options: 1) fix backend to include request-id+org validation before serving cached payload; 2) make prefetch cancelable and add org guard in frontend; 3) add short-lived per-org cache keys to avoid cross-org reuse.
raj: i dug into the prefetch cache key code, current key: `console:viewport:${userId}:v1:recent` (no org). that explains it. quickfix would be to append org id.
kevin: appending org id seems low risk and fast. but we should think about cardinality increase for cache store. how many unique keys per user? could be large for power users.
lina: agree on cardinality concern. maybe use a hybrid: `console:viewport:${userId}:org:${orgId}:v1` and add eviction TTL 30s to limit footprint. also emit telemetry `cache.key.cardinality` when we create new key.
amanda: timeline: we should ship a hotfix for staging asap (append org to key + 30s TTL). also add a server-side guard that validates response.org_id === requested org and drops otherwise (failsafe).
simon: i'll own the frontend cancelable promise work — follow-up PR to ensure prefetches abort on route change.
kevin: i'll do the cache-key change + server-side org check. want to coordinate so we don't ship conflicting changes to the cache format.
raj: can we add a small test in e2e that switches orgs rapidly and asserts no cross-org rows appear? i can add it.
amanda: perfect. also add a quick dashboard card under console pages telemetry: "fast-switch cross-org-rows" that alerts if rate > 0.1% over 5m.
simon: will add frontend metric `console.switch.fast.crossorg_hit` as boolean for each switch.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: staging/console-cache-fix -> started (build #2145). :rocket:
kevin: noted, i'll watch staging. if green, we'll roll to canary with a 5% rollout and watch the new metric.
amanda: thanks everyone. tagging @sre for post-rollout watchlist. if we see quota attribution drift, rollback and revert cache key change.
raj: opened issue #PLAT-4921 with repro GIF and suggested patch link: https://stash/redwood/plat/patches/4921 :link:
